title: Where to Watch FROM in India (Amazon Prime Video, Season 4 Guide)
hook: FROM is an MGM+ original series that is not available through MGM+ directly in India. Indian viewers can watch the show on Amazon Prime Video India, where Season 4 is currently streaming.

sections.heading: FROM in India - the short answer
sections.body:
For viewers in India, the simplest answer is this: FROM is available on Amazon Prime Video India. The series is an MGM+ original in the United States, but since MGM+ does not operate directly in India, Indian viewers access the show through Prime Video instead. Per JustWatch India, earlier seasons of FROM are also available on Amazon Prime Video India, and Season 4 is streaming there as well.

As of June 2026, FROM Season 4 has 9 episodes available on Amazon Prime Video India, with the season running for 10 episodes in total. That means Prime Video India currently carries almost the full fourth season, but not yet the complete run. For anyone asking where to watch FROM in India, Prime Video is the confirmed destination.

sections.heading: How to watch FROM on Amazon Prime Video India
sections.body:
Indian viewers who want to watch FROM should head to Amazon Prime Video India, which is the confirmed streaming platform for the series. Since MGM+ is a US service and does not operate directly in India, there is no separate MGM+ app or direct MGM+ subscription route for Indian audiences. Instead, Prime Video is the practical and verified option.

The process is straightforward. A viewer needs an Amazon Prime Video subscription. Once signed in, the easiest approach is to search directly for FROM within the Prime Video app or website. The series page will show the available seasons, including earlier seasons and the currently available episodes of Season 4.

This also helps avoid confusion with other services. There is no confirmed Indian listing for FROM on Lionsgate Play India. For Indian viewers, Prime Video is the platform that currently carries the show.

sections.heading: Season 4 - is the full season on Prime Video India yet?
sections.body:
Not quite. FROM Season 4 has 10 episodes in total, but 9 episodes are currently available on Amazon Prime Video India as of June 2026. That means Indian viewers can watch most of the season now, but the run is not yet complete on Prime Video India.

The remaining episode is Episode 10, which is scheduled to air on MGM+ in the United States on June 28, 2026. Because FROM is an MGM+ original series in the US, the release flow begins there. For India, the final episode is expected to follow after that US broadcast, but no separate confirmed India date for Episode 10 has been announced.

Anyone planning a complete binge may want to wait a short while for Episode 10 to land on Prime Video India, while viewers happy to catch up now can already watch the first nine episodes of the season.

sections.heading: What about Season 5?
sections.body:
There is good news for viewers already invested in the series. FROM has been renewed for Season 5, and that renewal was announced in April 2026 through MGM+ and Amazon MGM Studios. The upcoming fifth season is also confirmed to be the final season of the show.

What is not yet confirmed is the Indian streaming timeline. There is no announced India premiere date for Season 5. Based on the current setup, Indian viewers would logically expect the series to continue through Amazon Prime Video India, since that is where the show is currently available in the country, but no formal date has been listed.

The verified takeaway is that Season 5 is happening and will end the series, but Indian viewers are still waiting for a confirmed streaming date and schedule.

faq.a: No confirmed Netflix India listing for FROM is available based on current JustWatch India data.

faq.q: Is FROM on Lionsgate Play India?
faq.a: No. There is no confirmed listing for FROM on Lionsgate Play India.

faq.q: Is MGM+ available in India directly?
faq.a: No. MGM+ does not operate directly in India. Indian viewers access FROM through Amazon Prime Video India instead.

faq.q: Which seasons of FROM are on Amazon Prime Video India?
faq.a: Per JustWatch India, both earlier seasons and Season 4 are available on Amazon Prime Video India. Season 4 currently has 9 of its 10 episodes available, with Episode 10 airing in the US on June 28, 2026.
